blocks.html: Robinsons Malls, in partnership with the Philippine Franchise Association (PFA), facilitated employment opportunities for more than 1,600 job seekers through two job fairs held in Antipolo and Quezon City, reinforcing efforts to connect businesses with local talent and support economic growth within communities.

The job fairs, conducted at Robinsons Antipolo and Robinsons Galleria, brought together 31 franchise brands and thousands of employment opportunities across various sectors, providing a platform for businesses to engage directly with local talent while making recruitment more accessible to surrounding communities.

blocks.alt: Robinsons Malls Delivers On-the-Spot Hiring Opportunities to Job Seekers
blocks.cap: Robinsons Malls Delivers On-the-Spot Hiring Opportunities to Job Seekers

blocks.html: In celebration of World Franchise Day, Robinsons Antipolo hosted the first job fair last June 25, attracting 1,277 registered applicants from first-time job seekers to experienced professionals. Of these, 275 were hired on the spot, while 988 qualified for further consideration, connecting job seekers directly with employment opportunities from participating franchise businesses.

The initiative continued at Robinsons Galleria in August, where 386 applicants registered and met with participating employers. Nine applicants were hired on the spot, with other candidates referred for further consideration.

blocks.alt: Robinsons Antipolo welcomed a strong turnout for the PFA Job Fair, with job seekers arriving early and eager to explore career opportunities and pursue the possibility of being hired on the spot.

blocks.cap: Queues fill Robinsons Galleria as hopeful job seekers await their chance to connect with employers.

blocks.html: "By connecting employers and job seekers in our malls, we create meaningful, accessible opportunities that lead to immediate employment while helping businesses find the talent they need to grow," said Marilou Rhom, Operations Director Robinsons Malls. "We are proud to partner with the Philippine Franchise Association, DOLE, PESO, and our local government partners through initiatives that strengthen employment opportunities, support livelihoods, and contribute to the sustainable growth of the communities we serve."

The partnership reflects Robinsons Malls’ role beyond retail and leisure, opening its spaces to initiatives that create opportunities and make a meaningful difference in the lives of the communities it serves.

Robinsons Malls remains committed to working with industry, government, and private sector partners to bring opportunities closer to Filipinos, helping businesses find the people they need while giving more individuals a chance to build better livelihoods and pursue meaningful careers.
